statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has an unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance (I49.9)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The billed balance for this service is 934.22
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to correlate palpitations and dyspnea with underlying arrhythmias
